remarks: Sellers will consider offers between $739,900 & $789,900. Welcome to this stunning custom Stickl-built home just a short drive to the Niagara River, where boating, fishing, kayaking & waterfront walks await! Step inside to an impressive 2-story foyer w/ Brazilian cherry hardwoods. Formal dining rm offers space for gatherings, while the great rm boasts 18' vaulted ceilings, gas fp & tall transom windows for natural light. Main living area is pre-wired for 5.1 surround sound & CAT 6 Ethernet. Kitchen features abundant cabinetry, granite counters, newer SS appliances & central island. Ametek 2-stage water purification system serves fridge & island faucet. Adjoining eating area w/ arched window provides direct patio access. 1st-flr office can serve as 5th BR, next to half bath & convenient 1st-flr laundry w/ new cabinetry & quartz counters both updated in '26. 1st-flr primary suite features tray ceiling, walk-in closet w/ organizers & stunning ensuite remodeled in '22 featuring heated floors, imported tile, quartz double vanity & zero-entry glass shower w/ rainfall head, invisible drain & lighted niche. Upstairs find 3 add'l spacious BRs w/ walk-in closets & Jack-and-Jill bath. Expansive BR over garage (finished '20) offers versatility as media rm or living space w/ dedicated circuits, Ethernet & theater speaker wiring. Large dry basement features 8' ceilings w/ ample storage/workshop space, newer hi-eff furnace ('22), new sump pump ('24) & 50-gal Proline XE hot water tank w/recirculation system ('22). Outside, attached 2.5-car garage pairs w/ multi-car driveway extension perfect for an RV or boat. Fully fenced-in backyard set on a generous 0.62 acres with no rear neighbors. The property backs directly to protected, town-owned green space, where mature hardwoods, fruit trees, and perennial gardens create a stunning, scenic backdrop. Ideal for outdoor gatherings, featuring a massive patio with a built-in fire pit and a matching 14x10 shed that provides extra storage. This impressive property seamlessly combines premium advanced smart-home technology and custom craftsmanship found throughout the entire residence.
